mapper.insert: insert into QA_FA_RECORD ( ID, RECORD_NO, TEMPLATE_ID, PROCESS_CODE, LOT_ID, LOT_NAME, PRODUCT_PN, LINE_CODE, SAMPLE_QTY, SAMPLE_UNIT, SAMPLE_TIME, STATUS, CURRENT_ROUND, PROD_USER_ID, PROD_USER_NAME, PROD_SUBMIT_TIME, QC_USER_ID, QC_USER_NAME, QC_REVIEW_TIME, FINAL_JUDGE, PROBLEM_DESC, REJECT_REASON, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME ) values ( #{id}, #{recordNo}, #{templateId}, #{processCode}, #{lotId}, #{lotName}, #{productPn}, #{lineCode}, #{sampleQty}, #{sampleUnit}, #{sampleTime}, #{status}, #{currentRound}, #{prodUserId}, #{prodUserName}, #{prodSubmitTime}, #{qcUserId}, #{qcUserName}, #{qcReviewTime}, #{finalJudge}, #{problemDesc}, #{rejectReason}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.sql: R.ID, R.RECORD_NO, R.TEMPLATE_ID, R.PROCESS_CODE, R.LOT_ID, R.LOT_NAME, R.PRODUCT_PN, R.LINE_CODE, R.SAMPLE_QTY, R.SAMPLE_UNIT, R.SAMPLE_TIME, R.STATUS, R.CURRENT_ROUND, R.PROD_USER_ID, NVL(UP.FULLNAME, R.PROD_USER_NAME) as PROD_USER_NAME, R.PROD_SUBMIT_TIME, R.QC_USER_ID, NVL(UQ.FULLNAME, R.QC_USER_NAME) as QC_USER_NAME, R.QC_REVIEW_TIME, R.FINAL_JUDGE, R.PROBLEM_DESC, R.REJECT_REASON, R.CREATE_TIME, R.UPDATE_TIME
from QA_FA_RECORD R left join USERPROFILE UP on UP.USERNAME = R.PROD_USER_ID left join USERPROFILE UQ on UQ.USERNAME = R.QC_USER_ID
mapper.select: select nvl(max(to_number(substr(RECORD_NO, 11, 4))), 0) + 1 from QA_FA_RECORD where RECORD_NO like #{prefix} || '%' and length(RECORD_NO) = 14 and regexp_like(substr(RECORD_NO, 11, 4), '^[0-9]{4}$')
mapper.insert:
insert into QA_FA_RECORD_ITEM ( ID, RECORD_ID, TEMPLATE_ITEM_ID, SECTION_CODE, ITEM_CODE, ITEM_NAME, ROUND_NO, PROD_VALUE, PROD_PASS, PROD_USER_ID, PROD_TIME, QC_VALUE, QC_PASS, QC_USER_ID, QC_TIME, REMARK )
select #{it.id}, #{it.recordId}, #{it.templateItemId}, #{it.sectionCode}, #{it.itemCode}, #{it.itemName}, #{it.roundNo}, #{it.prodValue}, #{it.prodPass}, #{it.prodUserId}, #{it.prodTime}, #{it.qcValue}, #{it.qcPass}, #{it.qcUserId}, #{it.qcTime}, #{it.remark} from dual
mapper.select: select * from QA_FA_RECORD_ITEM where RECORD_ID = #{recordId} and ROUND_NO = #{roundNo}
